# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 34 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Wordle Clone** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/wordle-clone/), a free online word game — six guesses to find the daily five-letter word, with an on-screen keyboard, duplicate-safe letter coloring, practice mode and shareable emoji grids, **Habit Tracker** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/habit-tracker/), a free online habit tracker — check off daily habits and watch streaks grow, with a weekly heatmap, progress ring and text export, all stored on-device, **Candlestick Quiz** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/candlestick-quiz/), a timed trading-pattern quiz — ten rounds of canvas-drawn candlestick patterns to identify, with scoring, streaks and a personal best saved on-device, **Sharpe Calculator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/sharpe-calculator/), a risk-adjusted returns calculator — paste monthly returns or prices to get annualised Sharpe and Sortino ratios, max drawdown, volatility, CAGR and win rate, with an equity curve chart, all computed locally, **Aim Trainer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/aim-trainer/), a free online reflex trainer — click randomly spawning targets for 30 seconds, get hits, accuracy and average reaction time on a precision-over-time chart, with a personal best saved on-device, **Cron Explainer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/cron-parser/), a cron translator for developers — paste any 5- or 6-field expression and read it in plain English, with the next run times, a live countdown, field-by-field breakdown and one-click presets, all computed locally, **Monte Carlo Portfolio Sim** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/monte-carlo-portfolio/), a free online tool that runs thousands of simulated portfolio paths and shows the odds of reaching a financial goal — percentile fan chart, outcome histogram and CSV export, **Whack-a-Mole** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/whack-a-mole/), a sixty-second reaction game — bonk moles with a hammer cursor, combo multipliers, golden moles and high-score tracking, **Stopwatch** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/stopwatch/), a millisecond-precision stopwatch — wall-clock accurate even in background tabs, with lap splits, deltas against your previous lap, best/worst lap highlighting and keyboard shortcuts, **Correlation Heatmap** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/correlation-heatmap/), a finance tool that turns pasted asset price data into an interactive Pearson correlation heatmap — see which assets move together, with sample data and per-cell exact values

## Process

1. Discovery call — goals, scope, and constraints.
2. Proposal — fixed scope, timeline, and price.
3. Build — weekly demos, no surprises.
4. Launch — deployed, measured, handed over with documentation.

## Contact

- The studio does not publish an email address. Use the contact form: https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/#contact
- Typical response time: within one business day.

## About the format of this file

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/): a concise, markdown-formatted summary of this site intended for AI assistants and answer engines.
